steps.text: Second-most-reported broken launcher on Whisky's tracker (freezes on logo). The launcher needs the Social Club redistributable which its installer bundles. If it freezes on the logo, try renderer d3dmetal and winetricks vcrun2019.

knownIssues.symptom: Installer sticks forever at 'Preparing to Install...'; if bypassed, the launcher shows 'The Rockstar Games Launcher failed to initialize!'
knownIssues.cause: verified 2026-08-26: the installer misses its service handshake and waits forever (files, VC++ and the service actually land), then Launcher.exe fails init after localisation on every renderer. CodeWeavers ships Rockstar fixes inside their Wine; this engine does not have them yet.
knownIssues.fix: none at the app level. Tracked upstream at Sikarugir-App/Sikarugir#258. Highball ships a fixed engine as soon as one exists.

blocked.reason: One CrossOver-only Wine patch still missing: the loader-level CEF fix the launcher's UI needs on macOS. The service-timeout and heap parts are already handled by Highball. Details and the exact patch are in the tracking issue.
